items.title: 4.3.1 Combining Stacks and Queues to Evaluate Expressions

source_refs.note: Topic 4.3.1 (PDF 118, printed 115). The section gives no example; the answer is general knowledge, flagged.

blocks.text: Stacks and queues together help evaluate expressions, especially complex ones: they manage the order of operations, handle parentheses and make sure expressions are evaluated correctly.

blocks.prompt: In converting infix to postfix, what could hold the stack and what the queue?
blocks.explanation: The stack holds operators and parentheses; the output can be kept as a queue of tokens, read from the front when the postfix expression is evaluated. This pairing is general knowledge; the book gives no worked example.

items: Stacks and queues together manage operator order and parentheses in expressions.
